items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: She don't sing no more. Sing out here. What's her name? Oh, that Herb Moran sister? Lizzy? What's her name? Lizzy Mao.

ctx.x: Yeah. Used to sing, that girl used to sing the first time I was going to sing. What's her name? Used to sing there.

She don't sing no more. Sing out here. What's her name? Oh, that Herb Moran sister? Lizzy? What's her name? Lizzy Mao. Yeah, why? Yeah. Why? I was like, I I mean lately we used to sing, you see. We used to sing, but it used to help us out, you see.
Did you have any special numbers to sing?
